_comment: Individual-instance credential email sent by the send-email composite action (MorphoCloudWorkflow). Fetched at send time — edits here go live on the next /create or /email, no vendorize needed.
credentials_body:
Your MorphoCloud instance is up and running:

* **Graphical User Interface (GUI)**: Use the URL provided to connect from a web browser. For improved performance and responsiveness, you may also use a dedicated TurboVNC client. See [the user guide](https://github.com/MorphoCloud/docs/tree/main/user-guide) for more information.
* **Command Line Access**: Use the SSH information provided below to access your instance from the command line.

In both cases, the username is **exouser** and the passphrase (password) is provided below. The **entire phrase is the passphrase, including the spaces** — copy it whole.

**Connection Methods:**

- Web connect (copy and paste into your browser): `{{connection_url}}`
- SSH: `ssh exouser@{{instance_ip}}`
- TurboVNC: `{{instance_ip}}:1` (username is not needed)

**Credentials:**

- Username: **exouser**
- Passphrase (password): `{{passphrase}}` — the whole line, spaces included

**Important Notes:**

- Each session is limited to 4 hours. **Without explicit action, your instance will be automatically shelved after this time.** Around 3h30m into your session, a popup will appear in the graphical interface asking whether you'd like to extend your session — clicking "Yes" will delay shelving by another 4 hours. Alternatively, you can extend the session at any time before the timeout by clicking the **"ExtendInstanceSession" icon on the desktop**. If no action is taken, the instance will be shelved (shutdown) and all GUI or SSH connections will be disconnected. Your data will be preserved and the instance can later be unshelved (restarted).

**Supported Issue Commands:**

_Type a command below as a comment on issue [{{repository}}#{{issue_number}}](https://github.com/{{repository}}/issues/{{issue_number}}) and press the green **Comment** button to submit it — pressing Enter only adds a new line. One command per comment._

- `/shelve`: Shelve (shut down) **{{instance_name}}**
- `/unshelve`: Unshelve (restart) **{{instance_name}}**
- `/email`: Send this email with connection URL
- `/renew`: Extend the instance lifespan by an additional 60 days, one-time only.
- `/delete_instance`: Delete **{{instance_name}}**
- `/delete_volume`: Delete volume associated with **{{instance_name}}**
- `/delete_all`: Delete both **{{instance_name}}** and associated volume

If you have questions, please contact [{{contact_email}}](mailto:{{contact_email}}).
